item.title: 🟠 Critical VMware vCenter RCE flaw exploited for reverse SSH access
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
A recently patched critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-59310) in VMware vCenter Syslog Server is being exploited in an active campaign to deploy a reverse SSH tool for persistence and remote access. [...]

item.title: 🟠 Attackers Exploit SharePoint Authentication Bypass After Public PoC Release
item.description:
Why this matters: Auth bypass — review access controls and check for unauthorized access.
Threat actors have begun to exploit a newly disclosed Microsoft SharePoint vulnerability following the release of a proof-of-concept (PoC) code. The vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-55040 (CVSS score: 9.1), which refers to a critical security feature bypass that stems from weak authentication.
